description_en: Create a rewrite URL rule configuration for a site
description_zh: 新增站点的重写URL功能配置
name: CreateRewriteUrlRule

parameters.help_en: The site ID, which can be obtained by calling the [ListSites](~~ListSites~~) operation
parameters.help_zh: 站点ID，可通过调用[ListSites](~~ListSites~~)接口获取
parameters.name: site_id

parameters.help_en: The version number of the site configuration. For sites with configuration version management enabled, you can use this parameter to specify the site version for which the configuration takes effect. Default value: 0
parameters.help_zh: 站点配置的版本号。开启了配置版本管理的站点，可以通过该参数指定配置生效的站点版本，默认为版本0
parameters.name: site_version

parameters.help_en:
The rule content, which uses conditional expressions to match user requests. This parameter does not need to be set when adding global configurations. There are two usage scenarios:
Match all incoming requests: Set the value to true.
Match specified requests: Set the value to a custom expression, for example: (http.host eq \"video.example.com\")
parameters.help_zh:
规则内容，使用条件表达式来匹配用户请求。添加全局配置的时候不需要设置该参数。存在两种使用场景：
匹配所有传入请求：值设置为true
匹配指定请求：值设置为自定义表达式，例如：(http.host eq \"video.example.com\")
parameters.name: rule

parameters.help_en: The rule name. This parameter does not need to be set when adding global configurations
parameters.help_zh: 规则名称。添加全局配置的时候不需要设置该参数
parameters.name: rule_name

parameters.help_en:
The rule switch. This parameter does not need to be set when adding global configurations. Valid values:
on: enabled.
off: disabled
parameters.help_zh:
规则开关。添加全局配置的时候不需要设置该参数。取值范围：
on：开启。
off：关闭
parameters.name: rule_enable

parameters.help_en:
The URI rewrite type. Valid values:

static: static mode.
dynamic: dynamic mode
parameters.help_zh:
路径重写类型。取值范围：

static：静态模式。
dynamic：动态模式
parameters.name: rewrite_uri_type

parameters.help_en:
The query string rewrite type. Valid values:

static: static mode.
dynamic: dynamic mode
parameters.help_zh:
查询字符串重写类型。取值范围：

static：静态模式。
dynamic：动态模式
parameters.name: rewrite_query_string_type

parameters.help_en: The rule execution order. A smaller value indicates a higher priority
parameters.help_zh: 规则执行顺序，数值越小越优先执行
parameters.name: sequence
